analysis.one_line_summary: A silent aesthetic tutorial demonstrating how to achieve a bouncy, voluminous blowout using a heated round brush styler.
analysis.full_description: A creator demonstrates how to style long balayage hair using a pink and gold thermal round brush (Blowout Boost). The video opens with a result hook where she unrolls her curtain bangs to reveal immediate bounce. She then demonstrates wrapping and rolling front sections of hair, followed by a close-up curling motion, showing the resulting shiny spiral curl. The video ends with a showcase of the full blowout from the back and front.

on_screen_text.text: HOW TO GET THE PERFECT BLOWOUT 🤍

scenes.visual: Creator unrolling the thermal round brush from her front fringe/bangs.
scenes.action: Creator pulls the heated round brush out of her bangs, shakes out the voluminous curved fringe, and smooths hair with her hands while smiling.

scenes.visual: Creator styling a front side section of hair.
scenes.action: Creator glides and rolls the thermal round brush through a front strand of hair, rotating it downward to bevel and curl the end.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on the thermal round brush barrel wrapped in hair.
scenes.action: Hair wraps around the barrel bristles; creator slowly unwinds and twists the brush out to release a silky, defined spiral wave.

scenes.visual: Creator showing the back of her styled hair.
scenes.action: Creator runs fingers through cascading, voluminous layered curls from the back.

scenes.visual: Creator posing and admiring final hairstyle facing camera.
scenes.action: Creator fluffs and flips her bouncy hair with both hands, showing off the polished salon blowout look.
